Confluence 4: CRT, Candlestick Patterns, and Volume Indicators. Candle Range Theory (CRT) shows the 23:00 H1 candle acting as an accumulation range, followed by a strong bullish expansion candle at 00:00. Rising OBV and VPVR high-volume node at 81200 confirm institutional accumulation, supporting a preemptive limit order.

Confluence 5: Fibonacci Retracement, Standard Deviation, and MTF Alignment. The 0.618 Fibonacci retracement of the immediate H1 swing (81135.15 to 81444) sits at 81253.13, aligning with the -1SD of the M5 VWAP. Multi-timeframe alignment (H4, H1, M15 bullish) ensures high-probability continuation from this defensive staff.
